description: Creates or updates one function in Development and deploys it: source is ONE bundled JavaScript module (`export default { async run(ctx, input) { … } }` — no imports; bundle TypeScript and npm packages first), reach is what it may do beyond its caller's own rights ({ read: [collections], write: [collections], credits: "spend_caller", hosts: ["api.example.com"] } — everything absent is denied), secrets names the secrets it uses as {{secret.NAME}}; your human chooses which of reach.hosts each one may go to as they set it (you never set or bind one; a secret with no chosen host is sent nowhere). A relay runs it with a run_function action. Its secrets' values are your human's to set (function_secret returns the link) — never in a chat. Live gets it by promote (request_promote), which names its reach, hosts and each secret's binding for the founder; a secret's VALUE never crosses from Development (those are usually test keys): the function waits PAUSED in Live until your human sets each Live value (function_secret with env live returns where). Use a relay's verbs first; a function only when no verb can do it. This is what a founder may call custom code or a backend function.
name: put_function
title: Save a function
